headline: How to farm gold in Palworld
title: How to Farm Gold in Palworld | Mau Ranch and Coin Press | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need gold in Palworld one point zero? Early on, put a Mau on your Ranch. Its Gold Digger skill drops Gold Coins over time, and Mau Cryst does the same. Later, unlock the Gold Coin Assembly Line at technology level forty eight. It turns metal ingots into Gold Coins, about one hundred gold per ingot. Keep your workers rested, because that job drains their sanity. How do you make your gold? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 gold farming: Mau and Mau Cryst on a Ranch early, then the Gold Coin Assembly Line at technology level 48, about 100 gold per ingot.
